```{r}
# set package parameters
```

## filter and impute missing age data (median imputation)

```{R}

# filter data to exclude the missing age participant and the missing response data
subjDataNoAmb.cc <- subjDataNoAmb |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(Age) & !is.na(TrialNumber))

# first create a participant-level dataset
subj_dat <- subjData |> dplyr::select(ID, Age) |> dplyr::distinct()

# create a median imputation for missing age data
subj_dat.med <- subj_dat |> dplyr::mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age),
                                                   median(Age, na.rm=TRUE),
                                                   Age))

# now merge the imputed age data back into the main dataset
subjData.med <- subjData |> dplyr::select(-Age) |> dplyr::left_join(subj_dat.med, by="ID")

# now filter the dataset to exclude ambient-only stimuli
subjDataNoAmb.med <- subjData.med |> dplyr::filter(UASLAeq != "Baseline") |>
  droplevels()

```

## Aalmoes (NLR) HA curves

```{r}

paramKNLR <- c(0.168, 0.152, 0.138, 0.158, 0.189, 0.148, 0.116, 0.085)
paramX0LAENLR <- c(82.2, 78.9, 77.4, 81.8, 81.0, 83.8, 92.2, 93.4)

rangeLAENLR <- seq(50, 90, by=0.1)

pHALAENLRFunc <- function(paramK, paramX0, abscissa){
  pHA <- 1/(1 + exp(-paramK*(abscissa - paramX0)))
  return(pHA)
} 

pHALAENLR <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAENLR,
                        LAEScl = rangeLAENLR - lae_centre,
                        Quad1=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[1], paramX0LAENLR[1], rangeLAENLR),
                        Quad2=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[2], paramX0LAENLR[2], rangeLAENLR),
                        Quad3=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[3], paramX0LAENLR[3], rangeLAENLR),
                        Quad4=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[4], paramX0LAENLR[4], rangeLAENLR))

pHALAENLR <- pHALAENLR |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Quad1, Quad2, Quad3, Quad4), names_to="UAS", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAENLR LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAENLRAdj <- pHALAENLR |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                           LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

# make a new dataframe containing the min and max values at each LAE value from pHALAENLR
pHALAENLRUASRange <- pHALAENLR |> dplyr::group_by(LAE, LAEScl) |>
                        dplyr::summarise(pHAmin = min(pHA),
                                         pHAmax = max(pHA), .groups='drop')

# adjust pHALAENLRUASRange LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAENLRUASRangeAdj <- pHALAENLRUASRange |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                           LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

pHALAENLRAir <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAENLR,
                           LAEScl = rangeLAENLR - lae_centre,
                           Air_taxi=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[6], paramX0LAENLR[6], rangeLAENLR),
                           Helicopter_1=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[7], paramX0LAENLR[7], rangeLAENLR),
                           Helicopter_2=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[8], paramX0LAENLR[8], rangeLAENLR))

pHALAENLRAir <- pHALAENLRAir |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Air_taxi, Helicopter_1, Helicopter_2), names_to="Type", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAENLRAir LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAENLRAirAdj <- pHALAENLRAir |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                 LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

# filter for pHA~0.5 and pHA~0.25
pHALAENLRSel <- pHALAENLR |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
pHALAENLRSelAir <- pHALAENLRAir |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
```

## Kawai (EMPA) HA curves

```{r}

paramb0EMPA <- c(-11.06)
paramb1LAEEMPA<- c(0.17)
paramtauSrcEMPA <- c(-0.91)

rangeLAEEMPA <- seq(53, 80, by=0.1)

pHALAEEMPAFunc <- function(paramb0, paramb1, paramtau, abscissa){
  pHA <- 1/(1 + exp(-(paramb0 + paramb1*abscissa + paramtau)))
  return(pHA)
} 

pHALAEEMPA <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEEMPA,
                         LAEScl = rangeLAEEMPA - lae_centre,
                        Mav2=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            0, rangeLAEEMPA),
                        M300=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            paramtauSrcEMPA[1], rangeLAEEMPA))

pHALAEEMPA <- pHALAEEMPA |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Mav2, M300), names_to="UAS", values_to="pHA")

# make a new dataframe containing the min and max values at each LAE value from pHALAEEMPA
pHALAEEMPAUASRange <- pHALAEEMPA |> dplyr::group_by(LAE, LAEScl) |>
                        dplyr::summarise(pHAmin = min(pHA),
                                         pHAmax = max(pHA), .groups='drop')

paramtauAirEMPA <- c(-1.66, -1.68, -1.76)

pHALAEEMPAAir <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEEMPA,
                            LAEScl = rangeLAEEMPA - lae_centre,
                        Helicopter=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            paramtauAirEMPA[1], rangeLAEEMPA),
                        Propeller=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            paramtauAirEMPA[2], rangeLAEEMPA),
                        Jet=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                           paramtauAirEMPA[3], rangeLAEEMPA))

pHALAEEMPAAir <- pHALAEEMPAAir |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Helicopter, Propeller, Jet), names_to="Type", values_to="pHA")

# filter for pHA~0.5 and pHA~0.25
pHALAEEMPASel <- pHALAEEMPA |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
pHALAEEMPASelAir <- pHALAEEMPAAir |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)

```

## Gwak HA curves

```{r}

paramkGwak <- c(0.17, 0.178, 0.165)
param0LAeqGwak <- c(13.512, 13.47, 12.184)/paramkGwak

param0LAEGwak <- param0LAeqGwak + 10*log10(7)

rangeLAeqGwak <- seq(40, 85, by=0.1)
rangeLAEGwak <- rangeLAeqGwak + 10*log10(7)

pHALAEGwakFunc <- function(paramb0, paramk, abscissa){
  pHA <- 1/(1 + exp(-paramk*(abscissa - paramb0)))
  return(pHA)
}

pHALAEGwak <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEGwak,
                         LAEScl = rangeLAEGwak - lae_centre,
                        H12W=pHALAEGwakFunc(param0LAEGwak[1], paramkGwak[1],
                                             rangeLAEGwak),
                        F450=pHALAEGwakFunc(param0LAEGwak[2], paramkGwak[2],
                                            rangeLAEGwak),
                        S1000=pHALAEGwakFunc(param0LAEGwak[3], paramkGwak[3],
                                            rangeLAEGwak))

pHALAEGwak <- pHALAEGwak |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(H12W, F450, S1000), names_to="UAS", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAEGwak LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAEGwakAdj <- pHALAEGwak |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                             LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

# make a new dataframe containing the min and max values at each LAE value from pHALAEGwak
pHALAEGwakUASRange <- pHALAEGwak |> dplyr::group_by(LAE, LAEScl) |>
                        dplyr::summarise(pHAmin = min(pHA),
                                         pHAmax = max(pHA), .groups='drop')

# adjust pHALAEGwakUASRange LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAEGwakUASRangeAdj <- pHALAEGwakUASRange |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                             LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)


paramkGwakAir <- 0.229
param0LAEGwakAir <- 18.94/paramkGwakAir + 10*log10(7)

pHALAEGwakAir <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEGwak,
                             LAEScl = rangeLAEGwak - lae_centre,
                             Jet=pHALAEGwakFunc(param0LAEGwakAir, paramkGwakAir,
                                                     rangeLAEGwak))

pHALAEGwakAir <- pHALAEGwakAir |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Jet), names_to="Type", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAEGwakAir LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAEGwakAirAdj <- pHALAEGwakAir |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                   LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)


# filter for pHA~0.5 and pHA~0.25
pHALAEGwakSel <- pHALAEGwak |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
pHALAEGwakSelAir <- pHALAEGwakAir |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
```

```{r}
# compile pHALAEGwakUASRange, pHALAEEMPAUASRange and pHALAENLRUASRange into a single dataframe with a study column indicating the source study from 'Gwak et al.', 'Kawai et al.' or 'Aalmoes et al.'
```

# Change in mean annoyance rating - Parts A & B combined analysis

## Categorical variables

### fit logistic models: ordbeta glmmTMB and GEE fractional logit

```{r}

transform_dAnnoy <- \(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10, direction = 'reverse', squeeze = 'none')

```

#### model 1 formula

```{r}

# NOTE: the GLMM re formula has been reduced from the Bayesian version to what the TMB solver can handle
m1formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ 1 + PartTrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASOperation + UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASType + AmbientEnv*UASType +
  (1 + PartTrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) + AmbientEnv | ID)

# extract only fixed effects from m1formula
m1bformula <- update(m1formula, . ~ . - (1 + PartTrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl +
                                           I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) + AmbientEnv | ID))

# include personal factors
m1cformula <- update(m1bformula, . ~ . +
                     NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                     AgeScl + Sex + NoiseSensitivityScl +
                       Area_soundscape2)

m1Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(TrialNumber='TrialNumber', StimID='StimID',
                                all.vars(m1formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))
  
m1cData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(TrialNumber='TrialNumber', StimID='StimID',
                                 ID='ID', all.vars(m1cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))


```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m1bformula, data=m1Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m1cformula, data=m1cData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

set.seed(999)
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m1formula, dispformula= ~ UASOperation, data=m1Data,
                       family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                       control=glmmTMBctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(m1, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, verbose=TRUE)

m1b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m1bformula, data=m1Data,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m1c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m1cformula, data=m1cData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m1b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m1c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m1b.resP <- residuals(m1b, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE,
                      pch=1, col=mycolours[3], identify=10)

gee_residplot(m1b, residual_vals=m1b.resP,
              colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.3) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4, text=element_text (family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Fitted values", y="Standardised Pearson residuals")

m1b.resM <- residuals(m1b, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m1b,
                    clusterVar=m1b.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m1b.Cook <- cooks.distance(m1b, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m1b, clusterVar=m1b.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m1b)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

nd <- na.omit(m1Data)
ndc <- na.omit(m1cData)

me_predict_fn <- function(fit, newdata) {
  marginaleffects::predictions(fit, newdata=newdata, re.form=NA,
                                type="response",
                               allow.new.levels=TRUE,
                               vcov = FALSE)$estimate
}

m1_cv <- cv_glmmTMB(m1, K=cv_folds, id_col='ID', seed=cv_seed, workers=n_cores,
                   control=glmmTMBctrl,
                   backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                predict_fn=me_predict_fn,
                                agg_cols='StimID', data=nd) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m1b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m1b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)


m1c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m1c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=ndc, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

geeModelPerformance(m1b, m1c, transform=transform_dAnnoy)

compare_cv_results(list(m1=m1_cv, m1b=m1b_cv, m1c=m1c_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m1bpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m1b, newdata=na.omit(m1Data),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASEvents", "UASType",
                                                       "UASOperation", "AmbientEnv"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m1b, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m1bpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m1bpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m1bpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMn_PredMod_Bmark_Cal_geeQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m1b,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m1bformula
modelStep$final

```

##### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m1bformula, data = m1Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m1bformula, data=m1Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m1Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m1d <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance', standardize=TRUE,
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-40, nlambda = 500)

coef(m1d, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m1d, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m1d$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m1d$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m1d$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m1d$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m1d$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

## UAS info only

### LAE, events and trial sequence comparison model

#### model 2 formula

```{r}

m2formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)

m2Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID',
                                TrialNumber='TrialNumber', all.vars(m2formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m2formula, data=m2Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m2 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m2formula, data=m2Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m2, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m2_cv <- cv_glmgee(m2, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m2Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                                workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)


geeModelPerformance(m1b, m2, transform=transform_dAnnoy)

compare_cv_results(list(m1b=m1b_cv, m2=m2_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m2predMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m2, newdata=na.omit(m2Data),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m2, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m2predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m2predMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m2predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMn_PredMod_LAECal_geeQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}


```

#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m2.resP <- residuals(m2, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE,
                      pch=1, col=mycolours[3], identify=10)

gee_residplot(m2, residual_vals=m2.resP,
              colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.3) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4, text=element_text (family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Fitted values", y="Standardised Pearson residuals")

m2.resM <- residuals(m2, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m2,
                    clusterVar=m2.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m2.Cook <- cooks.distance(m2, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m2, clusterVar=m2.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m2)

```

```{r}
m2_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m2,
                               centred_vars=list(UASLAEMaxLRScl="UASLAEMaxLR"),
                               scaling_data = subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               PartTrialNumberStd=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### full SQ model

#### model 3 formula

```{r}

m3formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
  UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m3Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m3formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))
  

m3aformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASTonLdECMAPowAvgBinScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
  UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m3aData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m3aformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))
  

m3bformula <- update(m3formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR +
                       UASImpulsSHMAvgMaxLR)

m3bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m3bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m3formula, data=m3Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m3aformula, data=m3aData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m3bformula, data=m3bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)


```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m3 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m3formula, data=m3Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m3a <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m3aformula, data=m3aData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m3b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m3bformula, data=m3bData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m3, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m3a, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m3b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m3_cv <- cv_glmgee(m3, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m3Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m3a_cv <- cv_glmgee(m3a, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m3aData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m3b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m3b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m3bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

geeModelPerformance(m1b, m2, m3, m3a, m3b, transform=transform_dAnnoy)

compare_cv_results(list(m1b=m1b_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3=m3_cv,
                        m3a=m3a_cv, m3b=m3b_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m3bpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m3b, newdata=na.omit(m3bData),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m3b, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m3bpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m3bpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m3bpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m3b,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m3bformula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m3bformula, data = m3bData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m3bformula, data=m3bData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m3bData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m3c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance', standardize=TRUE,
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-2, nlambda = 200)

coef(m3c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m3c, s = "lambda.1se")


```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m3c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  # geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m3c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m3c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.55, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m3c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m3c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.55, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

 
if (saveplots){
    
  filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMn_PredMod_LAESQnet_glmnetQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

### full SQ model

#### model 5 formula

```{r}

m5formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
                        UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv + UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl+
                        UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
                        UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m5Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m5formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m5bformula <- update(m5formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR +
                       UASImpulsSHMAvgMaxLR)

m5bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m5bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m5formula, data=m5Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m5bformula, data=m5bData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m5b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m5bformula, data=m5bData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m5, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m5b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m5_cv <- cv_glmgee(m5, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m5Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m5b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m5b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m5bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)


geeModelPerformance(m1b, m2, m3d, m4, m5, m5b, transform=transform_dAnnoy)

compare_cv_results(list(m1b=m1b_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3d=m3d_cv, m4=m4_cv, m5=m5_cv, m5b=m5b_cv))

```

```{r}

m5bpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m5b, newdata=na.omit(m5bData),

  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m5b,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m5bformula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m5bformula, data = m5bData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m5bformula, data=m5bData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m5bData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m5c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance', standardize=TRUE,
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-40, nlambda = 500)

coef(m5c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m5c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m5c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_colour_manual(values = darker_paired) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m5c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m5c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m5c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m5c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

#### analyse population-average predictions

```{r}

m5dDataFit <- insight::get_data(m5d)

sharp_sweep_raw <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLR),
                       max(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLR),
                       length.out = 5)

tonal_sweep_raw <- seq(0.4, 1.65, by = 0.25)          # tonality levels in original units
lae_levels_scl  <- c(-11, -5, 1, 7)                   # LAE levels on the centred (Scl) scale

m5dpredSxT <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m5d, newdata = m5dDataFit,
                variables = list(
                  UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl  = to_model(sharp_sweep_raw,
                                                          "UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl", subjDataNoAmb.medScaling),
                  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl = to_model(tonal_sweep_raw,
                                                          "UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl", subjDataNoAmb.medScaling),
                  UASLAEMaxLRScl = lae_levels_scl),
                by = c("UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl", "UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl",
                       "AmbientEnv", "UASLAEMaxLRScl"),
                vcov = vcov(m5d, type = "bias-corrected"),
                transform = transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(LAEfac = factor(round(UASLAEMaxLR)),
                UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLR = num_factor(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLR))


```

## UAS-env loudness diff

### LAEdiff with events

#### model 6 formula

```{r}

m6formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
                            I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl))*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)

m6Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m6formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

m6bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
                            I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)


```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeParams(m6b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

```{r}
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m6, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m6predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m6predMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m6predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMn_PredMod_dLAECal_geeQb"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m6_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m6,
                               centred_vars=list(LAELAF50diffScl="LAELAF50diff"),
                               scaling_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               PartTrialNumberStd=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### full SQ model

#### model 7 formula

```{r}

m7formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
              I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
              UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl +
                                    UASImpulsSHMAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
                                    UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m7bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
              I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl))*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
              UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl +
                                    UASImpulsSHMAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
                                    UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m7Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m7formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))
   
```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m7formula, data=m7Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m7bformula, data=m7Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m7 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m7formula, data=m7Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m7b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m7bformula, data=m7Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m7, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m7b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m7.resP <- residuals(m7, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE,
                      pch=1, col=mycolours[3], identify=10)

gee_residplot(m7, residual_vals=m7.resP,
              colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.3) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4, text=element_text (family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Fitted values", y="Standardised Pearson residuals")

m7.resM <- residuals(m7, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m7,
                    clusterVar=m7.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m7.Cook <- cooks.distance(m7, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m7, clusterVar=m7.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m7b)
glmgee_vif(m7)

```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m7,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m7formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m7formula, data = m7Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m7formula, data=m7Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m7Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m7c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-40, nlambda = 500)

coef(m7c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m7c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m7c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m7c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m7c$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m7c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m7c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

#### analyse population-average predictions

```{r}

pred_mod <- m7d
fitDat <- insight::get_data(pred_mod)
vc <- vcov(pred_mod, type="bias-corrected")

n_sweep  <- 25

x_main    <- "LAELAF50diffScl"

x_sweep <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[[x_main]]),
               max(stimDataNoAmb[[x_main]]),
               length.out=25)

q_levels <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)            # quantiles used for "low / mid / high" slices


m7dpred <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = (list(x_sweep) |> setNames(x_main)),
                              by=c(x_main),
                              vcov=vc,
                              transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)


m7dpredEvt <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = (list(x_sweep) |> setNames(x_main)),
                              by=c(x_main, "UASEvents"),
                              vcov=vc,
                              transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)


# sqm 1
sqm1 <- "UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl"
sqm1_orig <- subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$variable[subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$new_variable == sqm1]
sqm1_q <- unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb[[sqm1]], q_levels))
grid_vars <- list(
  x_sweep, 
  sqm1_q
) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm1))

m7dpredS <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = grid_vars,
                                by=c(x_main, names(grid_vars)[-1]),
                                vcov=vc,
                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c(names(grid_vars)[-1], sqm1_orig)),
      ~ num_factor(.x, digits=2)
    ))


# sqm 2
sqm2 <- "UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl"
sqm2_orig <- subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$variable[subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$new_variable == sqm2]
sqm2_q <- unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb[[sqm2]], q_levels))
grid_vars <- list(
  x_sweep, 
  sqm2_q
) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm2))

m7dpredT <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = grid_vars,
                                by=c(x_main, names(grid_vars)[-1]),
                                vcov=vc,
                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c(names(grid_vars)[-1], sqm2_orig)), 
      ~ num_factor(.x, digits=1)
    ))

# sqm 1 x 2 interaction
sqm3 <- "UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl"
q1 <- 0.1
q2 <- 0.9
sqm1_sweep <- seq(-0.8, 0.72, by=0.3)
sqm3_q <- to_model(unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLR, c(q1, q2))),
                   sqm3, subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)
grid_vars <- list(
  x_sweep, 
  sqm1_sweep,
  sqm3_q
) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm1, sqm3))

m7dpredST <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, newdata=fitDat,
                                              variables = grid_vars,
                                          by = c(x_main, sqm1, sqm3),
                                          vcov = vc, transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLR = num_factor(UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLR),
                UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLR     = num_factor(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLR))

gc()

```

## UAS detectability

### fit and examine detectability only model

#### model 8 formula

```{r}

m8formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)

m8bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl))*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)

m8Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m8formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m8formula, data=m8Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m8bformula, data=m8Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m8 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m8formula, data=m8Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m8b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m8bformula, data=m8Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m8, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m8b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m8_cv <- cv_glmgee(m8, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m8Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m8b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m8b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m8Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

geeModelPerformance(m1b, m2, m3d, m4, m5d, m6, m7d, m8, m8b,
                    transform=transform_dAnnoy)

compare_cv_results(list(m1b=m1b_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3d=m3d_cv,
                        m4=m4_cv, m5d=m5d_cv, m6=m6_cv, m7d=m7d_cv,
                        m8=m8_cv, m8b=m8b_cv))

```


#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m8.resP <- residuals(m8, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE,
                      pch=1, col=mycolours[3], identify=10)

gee_residplot(m8, residual_vals=m8.resP,
              colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.3) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4, text=element_text (family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Fitted values", y="Standardised Pearson residuals")

m8.resM <- residuals(m8, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m8,
                    clusterVar=m8.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m8.Cook <- cooks.distance(m8, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m8, clusterVar=m8.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m8)

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m8predMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m8, newdata=na.omit(m8Data),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m8, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m8predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m8predMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m8predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMn_PredMod_DetCal_geeQb"
  
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

```{r}
                               centred_vars=list(Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl="Detect0p5dBIntMaxLR"),
                               scaling_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               PartTrialNumberStd=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### full SQ model

#### model 9 formula

```{r}

m9formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl))*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl +
                UASImpulsSHMAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
                UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m9bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl +
                UASImpulsSHMAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
                UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m9Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                all.vars(m9formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m9,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m9formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m9formula, data = m9Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m9formula, data=m9Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m9Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m9c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-200, nlambda = 600)

coef(m9c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m9c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m9c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean


# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m9c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m9c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m9c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m9c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

##### fit elastic net-informed model

###### formula

```{r}

m9dformula <- update(m9formula, . ~ . - UASFluctECMA10ExBin -
                       UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR)
m9dformula

```

###### run model

####### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m9dformula, data=m9Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)
```

```{r}

m9d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m9dformula, data=m9Data,

geeParams(m9d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

###### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m9dpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m9d, newdata=na.omit(m9Data),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m9d, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m9dpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m9dpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m9dpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

#### analyse population-average predictions

```{r}

pred_mod <- m9d
fitDat <- insight::get_data(pred_mod)
vc <- vcov(pred_mod, type="bias-corrected")

n_sweep  <- 25

x_main    <- "Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl"

x_sweep <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[[x_main]]),
               max(stimDataNoAmb[[x_main]]),
               length.out=25)

q_levels <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)            # quantiles used for "low / mid / high" slices


m9dpred <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = (list(x_sweep) |> setNames(x_main)),
                              by=c(x_main),
                              vcov=vc,
                              transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)


m9dpredEvt <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = (list(x_sweep) |> setNames(x_main)),
                              by=c(x_main, "UASEvents"),
                              vcov=vc,
                              transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)


# sqm 1
sqm1 <- "UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl"
sqm1_orig <- subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$variable[subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$new_variable == sqm1]
sqm1_q <- unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb[[sqm1]], q_levels))
grid_vars <- list(
  x_sweep, 
  sqm1_q
) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm1))

m9dpredS <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = grid_vars,
                                by=c(x_main, names(grid_vars)[-1]),
                                vcov=vc,
                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(c(names(grid_vars)[-1], sqm1_orig)),
      ~ num_factor(.x, digits=1)
    ))

# sqm 2
sqm2 <- "UASImpulsSHMAvgMaxLR"          # not centred: used in original units
sqm2_orig <- sqm2
sqm2_q <- unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb[[sqm2]], q_levels))
grid_vars <- list(
  x_sweep,
  sqm2_q
) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm2))

m9dpredI <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = grid_vars,
                                by=c(x_main, names(grid_vars)[-1]),
                                vcov=vc,
                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(sqm2),
      ~ num_factor(.x, digits=2)
    ))

# sqm 1 x 3 interaction
sqm3 <- "UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl"
q1 <- 0.1
q2 <- 0.9
sqm1_sweep <- seq(-0.8, 0.72, by=0.3)
sqm3_q <- to_model(unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLR, c(q1, q2))),
                   sqm3, subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)
grid_vars <- list(
  x_sweep, 
  sqm1_sweep,
  sqm3_q
) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm1, sqm3))

m9dpredST <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, newdata=fitDat,
                                              variables = grid_vars,
                                          by = c(x_main, sqm1, sqm3),
                                          vcov = vc, transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLR = num_factor(UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLR),
                UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLR     = num_factor(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLR))

gc()
```

### dSQ model

#### model 10 formula

```{r}

m10formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl))*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl*dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + dFluctECMA10ExBin +
  dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m10bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl*dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + dFluctECMA10ExBin +
  dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m10Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m10formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))


m10cformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl))*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl*dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl +
  dImpulsSHM05ExMaxLR + dFluctECMA10ExBin +
  dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m10cData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m10cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))


```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m10formula, data=m10Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m10bformula, data=m10Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m10cformula, data=m10cData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)


```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m10 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m10formula, data=m10Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
```
