#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m10cpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m10c, newdata=na.omit(m10cData),
                                                  by=c("StimID"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m10c, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m10cpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m10cpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m10cpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

```{r}
modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m10c,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m10cformula
modelStep$final
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m10cformula, data = m10cData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m10cformula, data=m10cData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m10cData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(80808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(80808)
m10d <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-200, nlambda = 600)

coef(m10d, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m10d, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m10d$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m10d$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m10d$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m10d$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m10d$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

##### fit elastic net-informed model

###### formula

```{r}
m10eformula <- update(m10cformula, . ~ . - dImpulsSHM05ExMaxLR -
                        dFluctECMA10ExBin - dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR)
m10eformula
```

#### analyse population-average predictions

```{r}

pred_mod <- m10e
fitDat <- insight::get_data(pred_mod)
vc <- vcov(pred_mod, type="bias-corrected")

n_sweep  <- 25

x_main    <- "Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl"

x_sweep <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[[x_main]]),
               max(stimDataNoAmb[[x_main]]),
               length.out=25)

q_levels <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.95)            # quantiles used for "low / mid / high" slices
  

m10epred <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = (list(x_sweep) |> setNames(x_main)),
                              by=c(x_main),
                              vcov=vc,
                              transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)


m10epredEvt <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                                variables = (list(x_sweep) |> setNames(x_main)),
                              by=c(x_main, "UASEvents"),
                              vcov=vc,
                              transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)


# sqm 1:
sqm1 <- "dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl"
sqm1_orig <- subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$variable[subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$new_variable ==
                                                 sqm1]
sqm1_q <- to_model(unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb[[sqm1_orig]], q_levels)),
                   sqm1, subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)
grid_vars <- list(x_sweep, sqm1_q) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm1))

m10epredT <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                variables = grid_vars, by = c(x_main, names(grid_vars)[-1]),
                vcov = vc, transform = transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(sqm1_orig), ~ num_factor(.x, digits=2)))

# sqm 2
sqm2 <- "dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl"
sqm2_orig <- subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$variable[subjDataNoAmb.medScaling$new_variable == sqm2]
sqm2_q <- to_model(unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb[[sqm2_orig]], q_levels)),
                   sqm2, subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)
grid_vars <- list(x_sweep, sqm2_q) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm2))

m10epredS <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, fitDat,
                variables = grid_vars, by = c(x_main, names(grid_vars)[-1]),
                vcov = vc, transform = transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(sqm2_orig), ~ num_factor(.x, digits=2)))

# sqm 1 x 2 interaction
q1 <- 0.1
q2 <- 0.95
sqm1_sweep <- seq(-0.1, 0.18, by=0.05)
sqm2_q2 <- to_model(unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb[[sqm2_orig]], c(q1, q2))),
                    sqm2, subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)
grid_vars <- list(x_sweep, sqm1_sweep, sqm2_q2) |> setNames(c(x_main, sqm1, sqm2))

m10epredST <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(pred_mod, newdata = fitDat,
                variables = grid_vars, by = c(x_main, sqm1, sqm2),
                vcov = vc, transform = transform_dAnnoy) |>
  add_original_units(subjDataNoAmb.medScaling) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLR     = num_factor(dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLR),
                dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLR = num_factor(dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLR))

gc()


```

```{r}
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-10, 10, by=1), limits=c(-2, 8)) +
    
    labs(x=x_labels[1], y="Mean change in annoyance")

sqm_title <- expression(paste(UAS~Delta*italic(S)^"*"*","~acum[A~"|"~"M-G-S"]))
p4 <- ggplot(data=m10epredS) +
    plot_theme +
    
    geom_point(data=stimDataNoAmb.medPlot,
               aes(x=.data[[x_main]], y=dAnnoyMean,
                   colour=.data[[sqm2_orig]]),
               alpha=0.55, size=2) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option='plasma', direction=1,
                          breaks = round(to_original(sqm2_q, sqm2, subjDataNoAmb.medScaling), 2),
                        begin = 0.2, end = 0.8, labels=\(x) sprintf("%.2f", x),
                        guide=guide_legend(title=sqm_title, reverse=TRUE)) +

    ggnewscale::new_scale_colour() +
  
    geom_ribbon(aes(x=.data[[x_main]], ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high, fill=.data[[sqm2_orig]]),
                alpha=0.15) +
    geom_line(aes(x=.data[[x_main]], y=estimate, colour=.data[[sqm2_orig]]), linewidth=1) +
    
    scale_color_viridis_d(option='plasma', direction=1, begin = 0.2, end = 0.8,
                        guide=guide_legend(title=sqm_title, reverse=TRUE)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option='plasma', direction=1, begin = 0.2, end = 0.8,
                       guide=guide_legend(title=sqm_title, reverse=TRUE)) +
  
    scale_orig(x_main, subjDataNoAmb.medScaling, by = 10, digits = 0) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-10, 10, by=1), limits=c(-2, 8)) +
    
    labs(x=x_labels[1], y="Mean change in annoyance")

p5 <- plot_slice(m10epredST, stimDataNoAmb,
                 x = "Detect0p5dBIntMaxLR", y = "dAnnoyMean",
                 colour_v = "dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLR",
                 facet_v  = "dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLR",
                 facet_labeller = label_bquote(rows = UAS~Delta*italic(S)^"*"*","~acum[A~"|"~"M-G-S"] %->%
                                                 .(as.character(dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLR))),
                 q = c(q1, q2), option = "mako",
                 colour_title = expression(paste(UAS~bar(Delta*italic(T))[Sigma]*","~tu[SHM])),
                 colour_breaks = to_original(sqm1_sweep, sqm1,
                                             subjDataNoAmb.medScaling)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 10, by = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 8)) +
  labs(x = x_labels[1],
       y = "Mean change in annoyance") +
  plot_theme


(p1 / p2) | (p3 / p4) | p5
```

## UAS all metrics

#### model 11 formula

```{r}

m11formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl))*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl*dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + dFluctECMA10ExBin +
  dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m11bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl*dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + dFluctECMA10ExBin +
  dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR


m11Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m11formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))


m11cformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl))*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl*dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl +
  dImpulsSHM05ExMaxLR + dFluctECMA10ExBin +
  dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m11cData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m11cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl))


```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m11formula, data=m11Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m11bformula, data=m11Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

geeCorStr(m11cformula, data=m11cData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE,
          transform=transform_dAnnoy)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m11 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m11formula, data=m11Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m11b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m11bformula, data=m11Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m11c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m11cformula, data=m11cData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m11, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m11b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m11c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m11_cv <- cv_glmgee(m11, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m11Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m11b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m11b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m11Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

m11c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m11c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m11cData), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy,
                  workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=transform_dAnnoy)

geeModelPerformance(m1b, m2, m3d, m4, m5d, m6, m7d, m8, m9d, m10e,
                    m11, m11b, m11c,
                    transform=transform_dAnnoy)

compare_cv_results(list(m1b=m1b_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3d=m3d_cv, m4=m4_cv, m5d=m5d_cv,
                        m6=m6_cv, m7d=m7d_cv, m8=m8_cv, m9d=m9d_cv,
                        m10e=m10e_cv, m11=m11_cv, m11b=m11b_cv, m11c=m11c_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m11cpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m11c, newdata=na.omit(m11cData),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "LAELAF50diffScl",
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m11c, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=transform_dAnnoy) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m11cpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m11cpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m11cpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +

  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
    
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m11cformula, data = m11cData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m11cformula, data=m11cData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m11cData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(999999)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(999999)
m11d <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-120, nlambda = 1000)

coef(m11d, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m11d, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m11d$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m11d$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m11d$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m11d$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m11d$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')


if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMn_PredMod_AllSQ_glmnetQb"
  
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}


```

```{r}
m11epreddLAEdS <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m11e, newdata=m11eDataFit,

                    LAELAF50diffScl=LAELAF50diffScl_sweep,
                    dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl=dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl_sweep,
                    dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl=to_model(
                      unname(quantile(stimDataNoAmb$dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLR, c(q1, q2))),
```

## Comparison between GEE-LM (PA) and LMM (CS) models with LAE predictor

### Timing comparison

```{r}

set.seed(808)

# benchmark timing
testdAm <- microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  
    'LMM_model' = {m0LMM <- lme4::lmer(dAnnoyance ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl +
                                         I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) + PartTrialNumberStd +
                                         (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl  + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) | ID),
                                                  data=subjDataNoAmb, REML=FALSE,
                                           control=lmerctrl)},
    
    'GEE-LM_model' = {m0GEELM <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(dAnnoyance ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl +
                                                      I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) + PartTrialNumberStd,
                                                data=subjDataNoAmb, family=gaussian(link='identity'),
                                                id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, corstr='exchangeable')},
    
    'LMM_metrics' = {performance::model_performance(m0LMM, metrics=c("RMSE",
                                                                     "AIC", "AICc",
                                                                     "BIC", "R2"),
                                                       estimator='ML', verbose=FALSE)},
    
    'GEE-LM_metrics' = {geeModelPerformance(m0GEELM, verbose=FALSE)},
    
    'LMM_prediction' = {m0LMMpred <- ggeffects::predict_response(m0LMM,
                                                      terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [all]",
                                                              "UASEvents [1]",
                                                              "PartTrialNumberStd [0]"),
                                                       type='fixed', margin='marginalmeans',
                                                       bias_correction=FALSE)},
    
    'GEE-LM_prediction' = {m0GEELMpred <- ggeffects::predict_response(m0GEELM,
                                                      terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [all]",
                                                              "UASEvents [1]",
                                                              "PartTrialNumberStd [0]"),
                                                       type='fixed', margin='marginalmeans',
                                                      vcov=vcov(m0GEELM, type="bias-corrected"))},
    times=10, unit='s', control=list(order='inorder'))

testdAm

lmmVsGEEdAm <- data.frame(model=summary(testdAm)[1,]$median/summary(testdAm)[2,]$median,
                          metrics=summary(testdAm)[3,]$median/summary(testdAm)[4,]$median,
                          pred=summary(testdAm)[5,]$median/summary(testdAm)[6,]$median,
                          total=sum(summary(testdAm)[1,]$median, summary(testdAm)[3,]$median, summary(testdAm)[5,]$median)/
                                sum(summary(testdAm)[2,]$median, summary(testdAm)[4,]$median, summary(testdAm)[6,]$median))

print(paste("Model:", lmmVsGEEdAm$model))
print(paste("Metrics:", lmmVsGEEdAm$metrics))
print(paste("Prediction:", lmmVsGEEdAm$pred))
print(paste("Total:", lmmVsGEEdAm$total))

ggplot2::autoplot(testdAm)
boxplot(testdAm)
```

# Change in highly annoyed

## Benchmark categorical variables

### model 12 formula

```{r}

m12formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ 1 + PartTrialNumberStd +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) + UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASOperation +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASType + AmbientEnv*UASType

m12Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m12formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m12bformula <- update(m12formula, . ~ . +
                        NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                      AgeScl + Sex + NoiseSensitivityScl + Area_soundscape2)

m12bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m12bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

```

### run model

#### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m12formula, data=m12Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12bformula, data=m12bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

#### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}


m12 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12formula, data=m12Data,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m12b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12bformula, data=m12bData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m12b_ar1 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12bformula, data=m12bData,
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='AR-M-dependent(1)')
```

### test model interactions

#### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m12,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m12formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m12formula, data = m12Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m12formula, data=m12Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m12Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m12c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-320, nlambda = 50000)

coef(m12c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m12c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m12c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m12c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m12c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m12c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m12c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m12predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12, newdata=na.omit(m12Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                           "UASEvents", "UASType",
                                           "UASOperation", "AmbientEnv"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m12, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m12predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m12predMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m12predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoy_PredMod_BmarkCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

```{r}
# send subset(m12predType1, UASEvents==1) to group_by to get min and max at each x (LAEScl) for geom_ribbon layers
m12predType1UASRange <- subset(m12predType1, UASEvents==1) |>
  group_by(UASLAEMaxLRScl) |>
  summarise(pHAmin = min(estimate),
            pHAmax = max(estimate),
            .groups = 'drop')

# incorporate m12predType1UASRange into pHALAEUASRangeAll with study 'Present study'
m12predType1UASRange <- m12predType1UASRange |>
  dplyr::mutate(LAE = UASLAEMaxLRScl + lae_centre,
                LAEScl = UASLAEMaxLRScl) |> dplyr::select(LAE, LAEScl, pHAmin, pHAmax)

pHALAEUASRangeAll_new <- rbind(pHALAEUASRangeAll,
                           m12predType1UASRange |> dplyr::mutate(Study = "Present study")
)

# repeat for pHALAEUASRangeAllAdj
pHALAEUASRangeAllAdj_new <- rbind(pHALAEUASRangeAllAdj,
                              m12predType1UASRange |> dplyr::mutate(Study = "Present study")
)
```

## UAS info only

### LAE only with events

#### model 13 formula

```{r}

m13formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)

m13Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m13formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m13formula, data=m13Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m13 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m13formula, data=m13Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m13, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m13.resP <- residuals(m13, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE)

used <- complete.cases(m13Data[all.vars(m13formula)])

arm::binnedplot(fitted(m13), m13.resP)
arm::binnedplot(m13Data$UASLAEMaxLRScl[used], residuals(m13, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASLAEMaxLRScl")
arm::binnedplot(m13Data$UASEvents[used], residuals(m13, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASEvents")
arm::binnedplot(m13Data$PartTrialNumberStd[used], residuals(m13, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "PartTrialNumberStd")

m13.resM <- residuals(m13, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m13,
                    clusterVar=m13.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m13.Cook <- cooks.distance(m13, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m13, clusterVar=m13.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m13)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13)

m13_cv <- cv_glmgee(m13, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m13Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m13predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m13, newdata=na.omit(m13Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                           "UASEvents"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m13, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m13predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m13predMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m13predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
```

### full SQ model

#### model 14 formula

```{r}

m14formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl +
  I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASTonLdECMAPowAvgBinStd*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd

m14Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m14formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m14bformula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl +
  I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd

m14bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m14bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m14cformula <- update(m14bformula, . ~ . + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525))

m14dformula <- update(m14bformula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd +
                         UASImpulsSHMPowAvgMaxLRStd)

m14dData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m14dformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m14eformula <- update(m14dformula, . ~ . + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m14formula, data=m14Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14bformula, data=m14bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14cformula, data=m14bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14dformula, data=m14dData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14eformula, data=m14dData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m14 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14formula, data=m14Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m14b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14bformula, data=m14bData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m14c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14cformula, data=m14bData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m14d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14dformula, data=m14dData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m14e <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14eformula, data=m14dData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')


geeParams(m14, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14e, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

nd <- na.omit(m14Data)
ndb <- na.omit(m14bData)
ndd <- na.omit(m14dData)

m14_cv <- cv_glmgee(m14, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m14b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m14b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=ndb, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m14c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m14c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=ndb, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m14c,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m14cformula
modelStep$final
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m14cformula, data = m14bData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m14cformula, data=m14bData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m14bData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(85858)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(85858)
m14f <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-40, nlambda = 800)

coef(m14f, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m14f, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m14f$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m14f$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m14f$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m14f$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m14f$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')


```
##### fit elastic net-informed model

###### formula

```{r}

m14gformula <- update(m14cformula, . ~ . - UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd -
                        UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd)
m14gformula

m14hformula <- update(m14cformula, . ~ . - UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd -
                        UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd - UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525))
m14hformula

m14iformula <- update(m14cformula, . ~ . - UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd -
                        UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd)
m14iformula

```

###### run model

####### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m14gformula, data=m14bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14hformula, data=m14bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m14iformula, data=m14bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
```

###### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m14g <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14gformula, data=m14bData,
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')
m14h <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14hformula, data=m14bData,
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m14i <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m14iformula, data=m14bData,
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m14g, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14h, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m14i, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

###### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m14hpredMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m14h, newdata=na.omit(m14bData),
                                      by=c("StimID"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m14h, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m14hpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m14hpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m14hpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoy_PredMod_NSQnetCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

## with ambient env classification

### LAE, events, env and trial sequence only

#### model 15 formula

```{r}

m15formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv

m15Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m15formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m15formula, data=m15Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m15 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m15formula, data=m15Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m15, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}

m15.resP <- residuals(m15, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE)

used <- complete.cases(m15Data[all.vars(m15formula)])

arm::binnedplot(fitted(m15), m15.resP)
arm::binnedplot(m15Data$UASLAEMaxLRScl[used], residuals(m15, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASLAEMaxLRScl")
arm::binnedplot(m15Data$UASEvents[used], residuals(m15, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASEvents")
arm::binnedplot(m15Data$PartTrialNumberStd[used], residuals(m15, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "PartTrialNumberStd")

m15.resM <- residuals(m15, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m15,
                    clusterVar=m15.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m15.Cook <- cooks.distance(m15, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m15, clusterVar=m15.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m15)

```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m15,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m15formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m15formula, data = m15Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m15formula, data=m15Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m15Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m15b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-20, nlambda = 500)

coef(m15b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m15b, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m15b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m15b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m15b$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m15b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m15b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

#### fit elastic net-informed model

##### formula

```{r}

m15cformula <- update(m15formula, . ~ . - UASLAEMaxLRScl:AmbientEnv)

```

##### run model

###### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m15cformula, data=m15Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

###### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m15c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m15cformula, data=m15Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m15c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```
##### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14e, m15, m15c)

m15_cv <- cv_glmgee(m15, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m15Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m15c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m15c, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m15Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14e=m14e_cv, m15=m15_cv, m15c=m15c_cv))

```

##### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m15cpredMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m15c, newdata=na.omit(m15Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                           "UASEvents"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m15c, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m15cpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m15cpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m15cpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoy_PredMod_LAEEnvnetCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### full SQ model

#### model 16 formula

```{r}

m16formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl*AmbientEnv +
  UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd
m16formula

m16Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m16formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m16bformula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl*AmbientEnv +
  I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRStd + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd

m16cformula <- update(m16formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd +
                        UASImpulsSHMPowAvgMaxLRStd)
m16cformula

m16cData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m16cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m16dformula <- update(m16cformula, . ~ . - UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525))
m16dformula

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m16formula, data=m16Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m16dformula, data=m16cData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m16 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16formula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m16b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16bformula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m16c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16cformula, data=m16cData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m16d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16dformula, data=m16cData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m16, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m16b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m16c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m16d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m16,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m16formula

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m16formula, data = m16Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m16formula, data=m16Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m16Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m16e <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-100, nlambda = 500)

coef(m16e, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m16e, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m16e$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = darker_paired) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m16e$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m16e$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m16e$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m16e$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')


```

#### fit elastic net-informed model

##### formula

```{r}

m16fformula <- update(m16formula, . ~ . - UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd - UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd)
m16fformula

m16gformula <- update(m16formula, . ~ . - UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd - UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd -
                        UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525))
m16gformula

m16hformula <- update(m16formula, . ~ . - UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd - UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd -
                        UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd)
m16hformula

m16iformula <- update(m16formula, . ~ . - UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd - UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd -
                        UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl:AmbientEnv)
m16iformula


```

##### run model

###### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m16fformula, data=m16Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m16gformula, data=m16Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m16hformula, data=m16Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m16iformula, data=m16Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

###### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m16f <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16fformula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m16g <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16gformula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m16h <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16hformula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m16i <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16iformula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m16f, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m16g, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m16h, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m16i, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

## UAS-env difference

### LAEdiff with events

#### model 17 formula

```{r}

m17formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + LAELAeqdiffScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)
m17formula

m17Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m17formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m17bformula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + LAELAF90diffScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)
m17bformula

m17bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m17bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))


```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m17formula, data=m17Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m17bformula, data=m17bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m17 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m17formula, data=m17Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m17b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m17bformula, data=m17bData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m17, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m17b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m17_cv <- cv_glmgee(m17, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m17Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m17b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m17b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m17bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()


geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14h, m15c, m16h, m17, m17b)

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14h=m14h_cv,
                        m15c=m15c_cv, m16h=m16h_cv,
                        m17=m17_cv, m17b=m17b_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m17predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m17, newdata=na.omit(m17Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "LAELAeqdiffScl",
                                           "UASEvents"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m17, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m17predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m17predMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m17predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoy_PredMod_dLAECal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}


```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m17formula, data = m17Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m17formula, data=m17Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m17Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m17c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-100, nlambda = 500)

coef(m17c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m17c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m17c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m17c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m17c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m17c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m17c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')


```

### full SQ model

#### model 18 formula

```{r}

m18formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd +
  UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  LAELAeqdiffScl +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRStd +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd

m18Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m18formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m18bformula <- update(m18formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd -
                        UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
                        UASImpulsSHMPowAvgMaxLRStd +
                        LAELAeqdiffScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525))

m18bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m18bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m18formula, data=m18Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m18bformula, data=m18bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

```{r}

m18b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m18bformula, data=m18bData,

                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m18, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m18b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```
