```{r}
m18c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-8, nlambda = 500)

coef(m18c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m18c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m18c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m18c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m18c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m18c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m18c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

```

##### fit elastic net-informed model

###### formula

```{r}

m18dformula <- update(m18formula, . ~ . - UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd -
                        UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd)

```

###### run model

####### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m18dformula, data=m18Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

###### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m18d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m18dformula, data=m18Data,
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m18d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

###### analyse performance

```{r}

m18d_cv <- cv_glmgee(m18d, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m18Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

geeModelPerformance(m18, m18d)

compare_cv_results(list(m18=m18_cv, m18d=m18d_cv))

```

## UAS all metrics

### model 19 formula

```{r}

m19formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
  UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd + dSharpAurSHMPowAvgMaxLRStd*UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd + dRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd
m19formula

m19Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m19formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m19bformula <- update(m19formula, . ~ . - UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLRStd +
                        UASImpulsSHMPowAvgMaxLRStd)
m19bformula

m19bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m19bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m19cformula <- update(m19formula, . ~ . - UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd -
                        dSharpAurSHMPowAvgMaxLRStd:UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRStd +
                        UASTonLdECMAPowAvgBinStd +
                        dSharpAurSHMPowAvgMaxLRStd:UASTonLdECMAPowAvgBinStd)
m19cformula

m19cData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m19cformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))
```

```{r}
eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m19predMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans

                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m19formula, data = m19Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m19formula, data=m19Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m19Data$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m19d <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-120, nlambda = 5000)

coef(m19d, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m19d, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m19d$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m19d$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m19d$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m19d$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m19d$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoy_PredMod_AllSQ_glmnetQb"
 
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}


```

```{r}
m19eformula <- update(m19formula, . ~ . - UASFluctECMA10ExBinStd -

m19eformula

                        dRoughFZ05ExMaxLRStd - UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl:I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)
```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m19e <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m19eformula, data=m19Data,

geeParams(m19e, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m19f, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

## Detectability model

### model 20 formula

```{r}

m20formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + Detect0p1dBIntEx50MaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)
m20formula

m20Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                 all.vars(m20formula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

m20bformula <- dHighAnnoy ~ PartTrialNumberStd + Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525)
m20bformula

m20bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', TrialNumber='TrialNumber',
                                  all.vars(m20bformula)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TrialNumber) & !is.na(dHighAnnoy))

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m20formula, data=m20Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m20bformula, data=m20bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, waves=TrialNumber, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m20 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m20formula, data=m20Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m20b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m20bformula, data=m20bData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID, waves=TrialNumber,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m20, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m20b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m20_cv <- cv_glmgee(m20, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m20Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m20b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m20b, id_col="ID", waves_col="TrialNumber", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m20bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14h, m15c, m16h, m17, m18d, m19e, m20, m20b)

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14h=m14h_cv,
                        m15c=m15c_cv, m16h=m16h_cv, m17=m17_cv, m18d=m18d_cv,
                        m19e=m19e_cv, m20=m20_cv, m20b=m20b_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m20bpredMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m20b, newdata=na.omit(m20bData),
                                      by=c("StimID"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m20b, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m20bpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m20bpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m20bpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoy_PredMod_DetCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m20bformula, data = m20bData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m20bformula, data=m20bData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m20bData$StimID[kept_rows]

set.seed(808)
stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m20c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-20, nlambda = 5000)

coef(m20c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m20c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m20c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m20c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m20c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m20c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m20c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "black", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(Penalty*","~lambda),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')
```

## Comparison between GEE-PA and GLMM-SS models with LAE predictor

### Timing comparison

```{r}

set.seed(808)

newData <- data.frame(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(-12, 13, by=1), UASEvents=1,
                      PartTrialNumberStd=mean(subjDataNoAmb$PartTrialNumberStd))

# benchmark timing
testdHA <- microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  
    'GLMM_model' = {m0GLMM <- lme4::glmer(dHighAnnoy ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
                                              PartTrialNumberStd +
                                                (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) | ID),
                                                  data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                                              control=glmerctrl)},
    
    'GEE_model' = {m0GEEGLM <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(dHighAnnoy ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.0906525) +
                                              PartTrialNumberStd,
                                                data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                                                id=ID, corstr='exchangeable')},
    
    'GLMM_metrics' = {
                        PCP <- glmmPCP(m0GLMM)
                        cbind(performance::model_performance(m0GLMM,
                                                             metrics=c("RMSE",
                                                                       "AIC",
                                                                       "AICc",
                                                                       "BIC",
                                                                       "R2",
                                                                       "LOGLOSS")),
                                    PCP)
                        },
    
    'GEE_metrics' = {geeModelPerformance(m0GEEGLM, verbose=FALSE)},
    
    'GLMM_prediction' = {m0GLMMpredict <- ggeffects::predict_response(m0GLMM,
                                                      terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [all]",
                                                              "UASEvents [1]",
                                                              "PartTrialNumberStd [0]"),
                                                       type='fixed', margin='marginalmeans',
                                                       bias_correction=TRUE)},
    
    'GEE_prediction' = {m0GEEGLMpredict <- ggeffects::predict_response(m0GEEGLM,
                                                      terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [all]",
                                                              "UASEvents [1]",
                                                              "PartTrialNumberStd [0]"),
                                                       type='fixed', margin='marginalmeans',
                                                      vcov=vcov(m0GEEGLM, type="bias-corrected"))},
    times=10, unit='s', control=list(order='inorder'))

testdHA

glmmVsGEEdHA <- data.frame(model=summary(testdHA)[1,]$median/summary(testdHA)[2,]$median,
                          metrics=summary(testdHA)[3,]$median/summary(testdHA)[4,]$median,
                          pred=summary(testdHA)[5,]$median/summary(testdHA)[6,]$median,
                          total=sum(summary(testdHA)[1,]$median, summary(testdHA)[3,]$median, summary(testdHA)[5,]$median)/
                                sum(summary(testdHA)[2,]$median, summary(testdHA)[4,]$median, summary(testdHA)[6,]$median))

print(paste("Model:", glmmVsGEEdHA$model))
print(paste("Metrics:", glmmVsGEEdHA$metrics))
print(paste("Prediction:", glmmVsGEEdHA$pred))
print(paste("Total:", glmmVsGEEdHA$total))

ggplot2::autoplot(testdHA)
boxplot(testdHA)


```

```{r}
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 1)) +
    
    scale_colour_manual(values=c("GLMM (CS)"=mycolours[3],
                                 "GEE-GLM (PA)"=mycolours[4],
                                "GLMM (PA)"=mycolours[6]),
                        breaks=c("GLMM (PA)",
                                 "GEE-GLM (PA)",
                                 "GLMM (CS)")) +
    guides(colour=guide_legend(title="Method", reverse=TRUE),
           fill=guide_legend(title="Method", reverse=TRUE)) +
    
    labs(x=expression(paste(UAS~italic(L)[AE],",",~dB)),
         y=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb])))
```
